preconditions.description: Number of cities is within the specified range.
Number of edges is exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct cities within the valid range.
Number of test cases is within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= uj <= n and 1 <= vj <= n and uj != vj for uj, vj, xj, yj in test_cases)
preconditions.description: JH's chosen cities are distinct and within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xj <= n and 1 <= yj <= n and xj != yj for uj, vj, xj, yj in test_cases)
preconditions.description: JY's chosen cities are distinct and within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
all(result >= 0 or result == -1 for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result is either a non-negative integer or -1.
